subject.title: fix(duckduckgo): forward the execution abort signal to web search HTTP requests

question: Which open PR should own the identical shared web-search abort-terminal change while preserving both providers' distinct signal-forwarding fixes?
rationale: Both viable branches modify the same generic production and regression-test surface, so selecting the canonical landing order requires maintainer coordination rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: SearXNG owns shared runtime
options.body: Land the proof-positive shared guard from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 and rebase this PR to retain the DuckDuckGo-specific handoff and its new live proof.

options.title: DuckDuckGo owns shared runtime
options.body: Require equivalent live proof on this PR, land it first, and rebase the SearXNG branch to retain only its provider-specific handoff.

recommendation.title: SearXNG owns shared runtime
recommendation.body: Land the proof-positive shared guard from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104216 and rebase this PR to retain the DuckDuckGo-specific handoff and its new live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared runtime capability and recent affected-path history make this the strongest available owner for coordinating which branch lands the generic change.
